result.finding: Single docker-compose.yml defines 2 services: 'oracle-db' (Oracle Database Free) and 'photoalbum-java-app' (the Spring Boot application). The app service depends on the DB service with a health check gate. No Kubernetes manifests or Helm charts present.
evidence: docker-compose.yml at project root: 1 file, 2 services defined

Service 'oracle-db': image gvenzl/oracle-free:latest, ports 1521:1521, named volume oracle_data, bind mount ./oracle-init, healthcheck configured (interval 30s, timeout 10s, retries 15, start_period 180s)
Service 'photoalbum-java-app': built from Dockerfile, ports 8080:8080, depends_on oracle-db (condition: service_healthy), restart: on-failure, SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker
Top-level volumes: oracle_data (named volume), networks: photoalbum-network (bridge driver)
No k8s/, manifests/, or helm/ directories found — no Kubernetes or Helm definitions
